help: <kbd>Arrow keys / 4, 6, 8, 2</kbd> navigate; <kbd>Enter / 5</kbd> confirms; <kbd>Space</kbd> ends the turn or confirms a card selection. <kbd>Tab</kbd> opens piles, <kbd>L</kbd> the log, <kbd>M</kbd> the map, <kbd>P</kbd> potions, <kbd>R</kbd> relics, <kbd>C</kbd> the compendium, <kbd>I</kbd> card details, and <kbd>V</kbd> statuses. <kbd>S</kbd> saves and <kbd>O</kbd> loads. Saves stay in this browser. With a mouse or touchpad, select a card and then an enemy, or drag the card onto its target; drop untargeted cards on the battlefield. Scroll to turn pages and click cards in piles to inspect them.
about: Pinned reference: v0.111.0 / 41cef1ea. Includes the five single-player character card pools, 53 colorless cards and 64 potions, with 558 card models including event and curse cards. Expeditions use the original three-act maps, single-player encounters, events and Ancients. Original UI and animation work is ongoing in this development build. Original artwork and animation are converted offline from the player installation.
